prompt: LLVM constrained frem rounding mode argument effect
answer:
For `llvm.experimental.constrained.frem`, the rounding-mode argument has no effect on the computed result because the floating-point remainder is never rounded. It is included for consistency with the other constrained floating-point intrinsics.

The argument still follows the general constrained-FP metadata rules and informs optimizer assumptions; it does not change the runtime floating-point environment. The exception-behavior argument controls the required exception semantics.
